title: Telling the Absent from the Slow — Part-Time Legislators Passing Laws
description: Chandra and Toueg's unreliable failure detectors: four part-time legislators in the Chamber of Paxos, attendance slates at the chamber doors that may be wrong, and how little they need to get right.
question: In an asynchronous network, a computer that has crashed looks identical to one whose messages are merely running slow, and that single ambiguity makes agreement impossible. How well must we tell the absent from the slow before agreement becomes possible again?
how: We find out by exploring how part-time legislators in the Chamber of Paxos, with attendance slates chalked at the chamber doors, agreed on decrees though the slates were often wrong.

papers.authors: Tushar Deepak Chandra and Sam Toueg
papers.title: Unreliable Failure Detectors for Reliable Distributed Systems
